brief:
Hundreds of dental clinics in Gaza have shut down, with remaining facilities facing closure, the Ma'an news agency reported. The closures reflect deteriorating conditions across the territory's healthcare infrastructure.

Dental practitioners have been unable to sustain operations due to prevailing circumstances in the enclave. The loss of these clinics removes essential dental care services from a population already struggling with access to medical treatment.
title: Hundreds of dental clinics close in Gaza amid crisis
